\section*{Question 3}

Let \(R\) be the region in the first quadrant enclosed by the graphs of \(f(x)=8 x^{3}\) and \(g(x)=\sin (\pi x)\), as shown in the figure above.
\begin{itemize}
\item[(a)] Write an equation for the line tangent to the graph of \(f\) at \(x=\frac{1}{2}\).
\item[(b)] Find the area of \(R\).
\item[(c)] Write, but do not evaluate, an integral expression for the volume of the solid generated when \(R\) is rotated about the horizontal line \(y=1\).
\item[(a)] \(f\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)=1\)
\[
f^{\prime}(x)=24 x^{2}, \text { so } f^{\prime}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)=6
\]
An equation for the tangent line is \(y=1+6\left(x-\frac{1}{2}\right)\).
\item[(b)]
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text { Area } & =\int_{0}^{1 / 2}(g(x)-f(x)) d x \\
& =\int_{0}^{1 / 2}\left(\sin (\pi x)-8 x^{3}\right) d x \\
& =\left[-\frac{1}{\pi} \cos (\pi x)-2 x^{4}\right]_{x=0}^{x=1 / 2} \\
& =-\frac{1}{8}+\frac{1}{\pi}
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[(c)]
\[
\begin{aligned}
& \pi \int_{0}^{1 / 2}\left((1-f(x))^{2}-(1-g(x))^{2}\right) d x \\
& =\pi \int_{0}^{1 / 2}\left(\left(1-8 x^{3}\right)^{2}-(1-\sin (\pi x))^{2}\right) d x
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[] \(2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: f^{\prime}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) \\ 1: \text { answer }\end{array}\right.\)
\item[] \(4:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { integrand } \\ 2: \text { antiderivative } \\ 1: \text { answer }\end{array}\right.\)
\item[] \(3:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1 \text { : limits and constant } \\ 2 \text { : integrand }\end{array}\right.\)
\end{itemize}
